title: An Unbiased ALMA Spectral Survey of the LkCa 15 and MWC 480 Protoplanetary Disks
question: What are the molecular inventories of the MWC 480 and LkCa 15 disks from an unbiased Band 7 spectral line survey, and how do they differ?

data.sensitivity: Per-channel rms 1.7–3.9 mJy/beam depending on SPW

what.value: Prior ALMA observations of 12CO, 13CO, C18O, DCO+, H13CO+ used as template filters

evidence.quote: We use prior observations of $^{12}$CO, $^{13}$CO, C$^{18}$O, DCO$^{+}$, and H$^{13}$CO$^{+}$ (cite: Huang_2017) to generate a bank of data-driven template filters

what.value: Disk inclination, PA, stellar and disk parameters in Table 1

recipe.method: Staff calibration, continuum self-calibration applied to full data, uvcontsub

recipe.goal: Image full band and extract disk-integrated spectra
recipe.method: Natural-weighted CLEAN per SPW with fixed elliptical masks; spectra extracted within masks
Apply bank of Keplerian data-driven template filters to continuum-subtracted visibilities, yielding filter impulse response spectra
key_parameters: templates: 12CO, 13CO, C18O, DCO+, H13CO+, plus H2CO, N2H+, CS from survey

recipe.goal: Image individual lines and measure fluxes
recipe.method: Natural-weighted CLEAN (robust 0.5 for >20σ lines), 1.5 km/s channels, integrate disk spectra over fixed velocity ranges, bootstrap errors

recipe.goal: Compare inventories and derive ring radii and upper limits
recipe.method: Flux ratios as proxy for abundance; deprojected azimuthal profiles for radii; CH3OH upper limit at assumed Tex
assumptions: Optically thin emission except CS and N2H+; CH3OH Tex = 25 K
